note: Links may not contain links (6.3). cmark-gfm 0.29 re-enables outer openers once any later '[' is pushed (no_link_openers) and nests the links.
cmark-gfm never opens an image before '^' (footnote syntax, even with footnotes disabled).
Decimal references have 1-7 digits (0.31.2 2.5); cmark-gfm 0.29 decodes 8.
0.31.2 declarations start with any ASCII letter; cmark-gfm 0.29 requires uppercase.
0.31.2 Unicode punctuation includes symbols (S*); cmark-gfm 0.29 only P*.
cmark-gfm's longest-match title regex reads \\) as \ + \) and runs to a later ')'.
Same cmark-gfm title scanner quirk with quotes.
Parentheses in a raw destination must balance; cmark-gfm 0.29 accepts an unclosed '('.
Raw destinations exclude ASCII control characters, and a backslash only escapes ASCII punctuation (0.31.2 6.3, 2.4); cmark-gfm accepts controls, markdown-it skips any escaped character.
cmark-gfm 0.29 caches the last closing-run position per length and misses a later code span after a failed search for a longer run.
0.31.2: <!--, text without -->, -->; both oracles use older comment rules.
Whitespace around a <...> destination is not part of the URL (cmark, markdown-it).
A blank second label acts like [] in cmark; the spec is silent and markdown-it differs.
